newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Chrysler EPS estimates cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Chrysler EPS estimates cut.

text.p: --Salomon Brothers analyst Jack Kirnan said he reduced his his first-quarter and 1997 earnings estimates on Chrysler Corp by $0.10 a share to $1.40 and $4.80, respectively. He maintained his hold rating on the stock.

--Kirnan said the reductions reflected the impact of a new incentive program for passenger cars scheduled to end in late March. It is the second major incentive program Chrysler has launched in the past 30 days.
--Goldman Sachs & Co analyst James Irwin also cut his Chrysler estimates by $0.10. He now forecasts the company will earn $1.40 in the first quarter and $5.15 for 1997.
--Irwin said he was not changing his market performer rating on Chrysler stock. He said the new incentive program, which is for dealers, will cost the company $575 per car.
-- Chyrsler shares were down 1-1/8 to 30-7/8 in early afternoon trading.
